notes: This file is a static export of current balance data and does not change gameplay.
Gold totals exclude enemies that can spawn dynamically from split, threshold, or boss phase mechanics unless those enemies are part of the scripted pack list.
Tower-side bonus gold, such as Nature bonusGoldPerKill, depends on which tower gets the killing blow.

conditionalGoldRules.condition: If an enemy has earlyKillBonusGold, add it when the pre-hit hp ratio is >= earlyKillHpThreshold.
If no early-kill rule is present, add goldBonusOnKill when path progress is <= 0.45.
Add each killing tower effect bonusGoldPerKill amount after enemy kill gold is awarded.

grunt.name: Grunt
grunt.description: Standard enemy. Used as baseline for balancing.

runner.name: Runner
runner.description: Fast enemy designed to pressure slow towers and reward Ice control.

swift_runner.name: Swift Runner
swift_runner.description: Advanced runner resistant to crowd control.

swarm.name: Swarmling
swarm.description: Weak individually but dangerous in groups. Designed for Fire and Holy.

fire_swarm.name: Ember Swarm
fire_swarm.description: Swarm unit resistant to Fire damage.

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: Heavy unit with uniform damage resistance—tough but fair vs all tower types.

linked.name: Linked Construct
linked.description: Conductive enemy vulnerable to Lightning chains.

shielded.name: Shielded Mage
shielded.description: Magical barrier absorbs chip damage; reduced mitigation to HP.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.description: Regenerates health unless burst down—slower regen at high HP.

splitter.name: Splitter
splitter.description: Splits into multiple smaller enemies on death.

siege_golem.name: Siege Golem
siege_golem.description: Heavy siege unit that spawns swarm reinforcements.

colossus.name: Colossus
colossus.description: Massive war machine requiring sustained focus fire.

worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
worldbreaker.description: Final boss that tests every tower role simultaneously.

basic.label: Basic
basic.description: Balanced starter tower with steady damage and reliable range.

fire.label: Fire
fire.description: Area damage and burn—punishes clusters, not single-target DPS.

tiers.label: Level 1
tiers.upgradeSummary: Stronger burn and damage (splash already built-in).

ice.label: Ice
ice.description: Strong slow and freeze—keeps enemies in range longer for all towers.

tiers.label: Level 1
tiers.upgradeSummary: Slowing aura—control without replacing your main slow.

tiers.label: Level 2
tiers.upgradeSummary: Higher freeze chance and stronger aura.

tiers.label: Level 3
tiers.upgradeSummary: Double damage vs frozen; vulnerability aura.

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.description: Chaining bolts with falloff—efficient burst across several targets.

tiers.label: Level 2
tiers.upgradeSummary: Fifth chain target and more range.

tiers.label: Level 3
tiers.upgradeSummary: Chains without falloff; periodic full-range burst.

nature.label: Nature
nature.description: Economy tower—bonus gold per kill; poison and roots from upgrades.

tiers.label: Level 1
tiers.upgradeSummary: +1 more gold per kill and poison DoT.

tiers.label: Level 2
tiers.upgradeSummary: Poison spreads on death; chance to root.

earth.label: Earth
earth.description: Slow, heavy shots—extra damage vs tanks, elites, and armored foes.

tiers.label: Level 1
tiers.upgradeSummary: Minor splash for packed lanes (tank-bust stays primary).

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Curse and weaken—amplifies damage everyone else deals.

holy.label: Holy
holy.description: Periodic pulse damage in range—supportive wave chip and auras later.

tiers.label: Level 2
tiers.upgradeSummary: Allied tower speed aura; periodic true damage on shots.

archer.label: Archer
archer.description: Pure single-target DPS benchmark—fast, long-range, no utility cap.

tiers.label: Level 3
tiers.upgradeSummary: Execute low-HP enemies and pierce volley.
